children: On September 18, 2026, the company received notice from Nasdaq that it is not in compliance with the Nasdaq Global Market minimum bid price requirement of $1.00 per share under Listing Rule 5450(a)(1). The notice has no immediate effect, and the company has 180 days, until March 17, 2027, to regain compliance, including by achieving a $1.00 bid price for at least 10 consecutive business days; an additional 180-day period may be available upon transfer to the Nasdaq Capital Market if conditions are met.
